thread:
mara.l: Proposal: "progressive credit unlock" experiment. Give 30 credits up front, unlock 120 after completing a tiny onboarding action (run + save a prompt). Goal = faster time-to-first-save and higher save-rate.

devin.h: Smart. Low friction but incentivizes the meaningful action. We should keep the landing microcopy explicit about "unlock more credits" so users know the goal.

zoe.r: Landing copy idea: "Start with 30 free credits. Ship one tweak, unlock 120 more." CTA: "Claim 30 credits". Include a short 4-frame GIF showing claim -> run -> save -> unlocked.

sam.g: Metrics to track: 24h prompt_run_rate, prompt_save_rate, time_to_unlock median, 14d paid conversion. Also track refund/fraud signals.

ops-bot: Ops notes: add utm_source=progunlock, create LD flag prog_unlock_flow, and set hubspot.lead_source to prog_unlock. Add cooldown 24h to prevent repeat claims.

mara.l: Experiment cohorts: open_150 (no gate), prog_unlock_30 (gate), control_50. Split 33/34/33. Need feature flag to flip copy and flow.

devin.h: Can Growth Ops wire the split? @ops-bot also need a user property credits_granted for reporting.

ops-bot: Affirmative. Will create flag and property. ETA EOD. Will also log claim_timestamp and device_fingerprint for fraud checks.

zoe.r: Quick email subject A/B: A) "Start with 30 credits, unlock 120 more" B) "Ship a prompt, get 120 bonus credits". Short preview copy.

sam.g: Keep social posts short: "Ship a prompt, unlock more credits" + demo GIF. Also call out "no card" in the thread copy.

mara.l: Hypothesis doc: small upfront credit + task will increase 7-day retention among new users who save a prompt, while keeping overall paid conversion neutral. We'll run 7-day and 14-day analyses.

devin.h: Implementation notes: landing preloads 3 starter prompts (copy, code, customer reply). Run/save events should fire before credit unlock. Add success toast with micro-survey: "What made you save this prompt? [useful|easy|other]".

zoe.r: Creative owner: I'll assemble GIF + landing mock in Figma and drop in drive. Email copy I'll draft and share for review.

ops-bot: Checklist: LD flag, UTM params, hubspot mapping, analytics events (claim, run, save, unlock), cooldown, fraud logging.

growth-bot: Reminder: add a quick eval harness to validate starter prompts for quality/regression. Link placeholder: https://internal/evals/prog-unlock-v1

mara.l: Launch plan: soft internal test Thursday AM, public Friday 10am PT, office hours Friday 3pm PT. Daily dashboard first 72h. Team owners: Zoe (creatives), Devin (events), Ops-bot (flags), Mara (experiment owner).

sam.g: Sounds good. I'll prep the social copy and GIF edits. Ping me when GIF is in drive.

mara.l: Thanks team. Quick sync 9:30am tomorrow for sign-offs.
